outcome: Whole quit disconnects locally regardless of RPC success; child expiry is terminal on Android and host; safe subsequent Play still works.

resolved_decision.contract: Gate every MoonWaker launch, resume, reconnect/replacement, warm-up and full quit through an exclusive Gateway control-operation lease. Android may execute the existing Sunshine bootstrap directly only while holding that exact permit, because Gateway cannot produce riKey/sessionUrl0. Keep media transport direct to Sunshine. Serialize start/stop under one authoritative Gateway generation plus actor lease epoch and durable operation result. Concurrent legacy/non-MoonWaker control is unsupported; an unmanaged, uncertain or uncorrelated Sunshine session must fail closed instead of receiving global cleanup.

architecture_boundary: Reuse GatewayState child accounting/session/policy state and OperationJournal; add only the missing control generation/effect-time fence.
Reuse BridgeState exact game/process identity and enforcement; isolate policy from HTTP routing without copying ownership.
Extract Game local terminal orchestration without retaining Game; reuse TransportStopCoordinator and LaunchTransitionController.
Remove every unfenced direct MoonWaker NvHTTP launch/resume/quit caller; the required Android bootstrap effect may remain direct only inside the exact Gateway permit lifetime.
minimum_compatibility_matrix: new client + old host: local stop succeeds; unsupported host cleanup fails explicitly

new client + new host: capability advertised only after full effect-time integration
